headword: {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}

definitions.explanation: Luggage that is handed over at the airline check-in counter to be loaded into the aircraft's cargo hold, as opposed to carry-on baggage.

examples.japanese: {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}は{二|ふた}つまで{無料|むりょう}です。
examples.english: You can check up to two bags for free.

examples.japanese: {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}の{重量|じゅうりょう}{制限|せいげん}を{超|こ}えてしまった。
examples.english: I exceeded the weight limit for checked baggage.

examples.japanese: LCCでは{預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}が{有料|ゆうりょう}の{場合|ばあい}が{多|おお}いので、{機内|きない}{持|も}ち{込|こ}みだけで{済|す}ませるようにしている。
examples.english: Since checked baggage is often paid on budget airlines, I try to manage with just carry-on.

notes:
Composed of {預|あず}け{入|い}れ (depositing/checking in) + {荷物|にもつ} (luggage/baggage). This is the standard airline term for luggage checked into the cargo hold.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}の{制限|せいげん}: checked baggage restrictions
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}が{有料|ゆうりょう}: checked baggage is paid
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}を{受|う}け{取|と}る: to pick up checked baggage
- {預|あず}け{入|い}れ{荷物|にもつ}{無料|むりょう}{枠|わく}: free checked baggage allowance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受託|じゅたく}{手荷物|てにもつ}: checked baggage — a more formal synonym used in official airline documents
- {機内|きない}{持|も}ち{込|こ}み{手荷物|てにもつ}: carry-on baggage — luggage taken into the cabin
- {手荷物|てにもつ}: hand luggage — can refer to either carry-on or baggage in general

USAGE:
With the rise of LCC ({格安|かくやす}{航空|こうくう}{会社|がいしゃ}), awareness of checked baggage fees has increased among Japanese travelers.
